Commentary.Commentary: Southee goes on to collect the trophy and is swarmed by his teammates. They pose and smile for the shutterbugs! So that's that, folks! 1-0 in the Tests, 3-0 in the ODIs, 1-0 in the only T20I! Sri Lanka have finished the tour without a win. They did play well in patches but patches aren't enough to win games or series'. Looking forward though, New Zealand welcome the mighty Indians for a limited-overs tour and Sri Lanka travel to the island of Australia for another tough tour. It has been lovely bringing you the coverage of this tour. Join us for the upcoming games as well. As of now, lots of cricket still going on! Switch tabs to follow the final Test between South Africa and Pakistan, where the hosts are batting first at Johannesburg or if you want more exciting and faster T20 action, switch tabs to the BBL where the Melbourne Stars have been set a target of 179 by the Adelaide Strikers. Adios from here! Take care!

Tim Southee the winning skipper of New Zealand says that it is always nice to lead the country even if it was for a one-off game and finish off on the right side of the result. Says that is a great team performance to come back from the position they were in after the first half of their batting innings. Assigns special praise for Lockie Ferguson and Mitchell Santner for coming back from injury and performing well. Applauds all the performers in this game as well, saying that the players are comfortable and whenever they are given an opportunity, they are ready to come out and perform their best. Thanks Sri Lanka for being a lovely touring side and feels they played good, competitive cricket even though they did not win a game on the tour. Signs off by saying there is lots of cricket coming up. Reckons it will be a tough series against the Indians. Looks forward to it.

Lasith Malinga the Sri Lankan skipper, feels that they did really well with the ball early on in the innings and gave away too many towards the end. He still reckons that the score of 180 was still achieveable on this ground. Says that the batsmen did not frame the chase well and did not understand how to cross the line. Feels that going ahead, they must do better in that aspect. Signs off by saying that there are a busy couple of months of cricket coming up where they have to step up and learn to win games.

Doug Bracewell is the Man of the match. He says it is a good result and feels it was a nice way to come back in the side and help in the win after working on his technique in the time he spent outside. Applauds his mate Kuggeleijn for a great debut. Feels that he was doing well at the nets and just came and kept things simple as he came to the middle and played his shots. Ends by saying he backs himself to do well whenever he plays.

With 180 to chase and a small ground, despite losing an early wicket, Dickwella and Kusal Perera blasted their side off to a fast start. Both departed shortly, but Thisara continued the fight like he did in the ODIs earlier. The task was too much for him to do alone, so he succumbed and post that, it was just a mere formality as the rest to come were cleaned up within no time. Everyone had a share in the wickets column, with Ferguson and Sodhi taking 3 apiece. A fine performance from the home side.

A clinical victory for the Black Caps in the end. They had some hiccups on the way, but eventually they stood tall and got the job done. First, they stumbled with the bat when they were reduced to 33/4 inside the Powerplay courtesy Malinga and Rajitha, but some calm sense from Taylor combined with fireworks from the returning Bracewell and debutant Kuggeleijn saw them end up with a massive total on the board.

OUT! It's all over! Sri Lanka have been bowled out for 144 inside 17 overs. NEW ZEALAND WIN THE ONE-OFF T20I BY 35 RUNS. This one is flighted on middle and Rajitha goes for a huge one over mid-wicket, but the ball takes the top edge and goes straight up in the air. The keeper, Seifert, makes a loud call for it, comes under the ball and takes it comfortably with his big gloves. Sodhi ends with three wickets and there is jubilation amongst all the Kiwi players.
Well outside off, Rajitha goes after it but can't connect. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Another flighted one outside off, slogged away to mid-wicket on one bounce by Sandakan. A single is taken.
Flatter one on middle, defended back down the ground towards the bowler.
Lakshan Sandakan is the last man in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! Gone off the second ball! Kuggeleijn takes a simple catch coming in from short third man. Nine down now! Looks like SL might not last the quota of 20 overs even. Slower one this time well outside off, Kumara looks to smash it down the ground but gets a thick outside edge that goes straight to Scott. What an evening for the debutant as well.
FOUR! Kumara uses his feet and smashes this flatter one on leg right back over the bowler's head for a boundary off the first ball he faces. Lovely shot.
Flighted delivery outside off, Rajitha fails to connect it with his defensive bat.
Lahiru Kumara is out next.

OUT! Lasith Malinga is back to the pavilion and New Zealand inching closer to the victory line. Santner bowls it wide outside off after seeing Malinga make room for himself for a slog. Malinga tries to go for it but all he manages is to find a top edge and Guptill takes a dolly at long on. The small hope that Sri Lanka had has just went down the drain here.
Flighted delivery on middle and leg, Rajitha plays it to the fielder at long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, the Sri Lanka skipper pushes it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Lucky boundary for Malinga. Tossed up on middle, it finds the inside edge of the bat and moves to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Santner bowls it way outside off this time. Malinga has a go at it but misses. The umpire signals it as wide.
Tossed up on off, Rajitha pushes it away through cover for a single.
Fuller one on off, pushed back to long off for a single to end the over. Brilliant stuff from Sodhi, just two off it in the end and a wicket to boot!
Beaten! A flighted one outside off, turns away late to beat the willow of Kasun as he was trying to defend it.
Flatter ball on off, pushed back to the bowler by Rajitha.
Flighted one on middle and off, Malinga hits it in the air towards long on. Goes on one bounce to Bracewell. Single taken.
Flatter one outside off, pushed away to cover by Malinga.
Lasith Malinga walks out to the middle next.

OUT! What a brilliant review! Three reds flash and the original decision will have to be overturned and it is curtains for Shanaka and for his team, most probably. A flatter one landing on leg and the ball turns a bit. Dasun who was looking to flick misses the ball and gets rapped on the pads. Loud appeal follows but it is turned down by the umpire. Southee goes upstairs almost immediately. The Snicko is clear, and Ball Tracking shows us that the ball was pitched on line, hit in line and would have gone on to hit the top of leg. The decision is overturned, Shanaka departs! Sri Lanka in troubled waters now. Seven down, need 52 off 35 balls now.
And immediately a review is taken. It is for an lbw decision against Dasun Shanaka. Looks close.
Ish Sodhi returns.
On the pads this time and Shanaka flicks it away on the leg side for single.
Flighted delivery on middle this time Rajitha pushes it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, driven away through mid on for a single.
FOUR! Loopy delivery by Mitchell, Shanaka opens the face of the bat and helps it towards the vacant third man region for a boundary. Important boundary here for Sri Lanka.
A very slower and shorter ball on middle by Santner, Rajitha flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up on off by Santner, Shanaka comes down the track and hits it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Kasun Rajitha is out next. Also, Mitchell Santner is back into the attack.

OUT! Cleaned him up! A fiery 147.4 kph yorker and the stumps have been disturbed! Ferguson is on fire here! Runs in hard and bowls this on the base of off stump. It is too good for Dhananjaya as he fails to keep it out. Sri Lanka are losing their way here! 61 now needed off 42 balls and the main batsmen are all back in the dugout.
Well down the leg side, de Silva cannot connect his shot. Called a wide!

Would have been a gonner had Guptill hit the stumps there! Length ball outside off, guided to backward point. The batsmen go for a single but Shanaka sends de Silva back after he is halfway down. Guptill picks it up and has a shy but throws it too high. A good chance wasted. Had more time there to take aim one would feel!
On a length and defended back down the ground by Dhananjaya.
Dasun Shanaka is next to the crease.

OUT! Lockie Ferguson with the breakthrough and it's the huge wicket of Thisara Perera. He tries to clear long on but he cannot. All he does is find Bracewell who has had a brilliant game and he takes an easy catch. Thisara Perera was looking dangerous out in the middle and was Sri Lanka's biggest hope to ensure they won this one, but he is unable to make them see the light at the end of the tunnel.
Fuller length delivery, de Silva flicks it away for a single through the mid-wicket.
Starts off with a length delivery on middle and leg, de Silva moves on the leg side. He tries to flick it but the ball hits him on his pad.
Lockie Ferguson is back for another burst.
Play and a miss! Kuggeleijn angles it across on a good length, Thisara Perera looks to smash this through the covers but fails to make connection. 63 needed to win in 48.
In the channel outside off, on a length, run down to third man. Another run taken.
Short of a good length on the stumps, pulled through square leg for a single.
Good running. Thisara works it through mid-wicket gently. Runs the first one hard and manages to come back for the second.
FOUR! Shot. That's terrific placement from Thisara. It's too straight, so he just helps it off his hips and places it wide of backward square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length ball angling in on off, de Silva taps it wide of backward point for one.
Scott Kuggeleijn is back on.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, de Silva lofts it over the mid on region and reaches the long on fielder on a bounce. The batsmen take a single.
Follows the six with a single by flicking it to the leg side. Good batting here by Thisara.
SIX! Perera smacks that one over long off for a maximum. It was tossed up by Ish and Perera picked the bones out of that one and heaves it over the long off boundary for a maximum.
Ish bowling it short there and Dhananjaya pulls it away for a single.
Short of a length by Sodhi and it is blocked by de Silva off the backfoot.

FOUR! Lucky for de Silva! Ish bowls the googly, Dhananjaya is late onto his shot and manages to find the inside edge and luckily for him the ball misses the stumps and goes towards the fine leg fence for a boundary. Sodhi is unlucky there.
Length ball outside off to start, Dhananjaya runs it down to third man for a single. Keeps strike for the next over.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new batsman.

OUT! Mendis has to go! A brilliant leg cutter from Southee from the back of his hand has done the trick. On a short length and the ball jumps off a length and gets big on Mendis as he is trying to pull this one over mid-wicket. The ball hits him high on the bat and goes in the air towards mid off where Kuggeleijn takes a very simple catch. The Lankans lose their fourth. Now need 86 in 61 balls.
Yorker length ball, Perera takes it on the full and hits it to long on for another single.
Short length ball on middle, punched back down the ground to long on for a single.
Beaten! Outside off on a length and moving away slightly. Mendis tries to run it down to third man but misses.
Length ball outside off, Mendis hits it slightly in the air towards cover. Ferguson dives to his right and makes a good stop.
Tim Southee comes back on, just one over for Santner.
No he cannot. Loops it up, Perera tries to cut it away but doesn't time it too well but fortunately for him the ball falls just short of the fielder at point.
Flighted delivery on off, Mendis rocks onto his backfoot and punches the ball through the point region for a single. Can he end it with a wicket here?
Ish misses his line and bowls it way outside the off stump. The umpire signals it as wide.
Tossed up outside off, Kusal hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Pulls back his length Sodhi and Thisara cuts it away for a single.
FOUR! Wonderful shot by Thisara Perera. He rocks onto the backfoot and punches it through wide of long on for a boundary. He is looking dangerous out in the middle.
Starts off with a google on middle and off stump, Perera cuts it away for a couple.
Ish Sodhi is now into the attack.

Flatter ball on the leg stump, worked away to the deep, square on the leg side for a single to end the over. 10 off it in the end. A good one for Sri Lanka. They're still scoring at more than 10 RPO. Need 97 in 72 balls now.
Slower through the air, wide outside off on a shorter length. Mendis pushes it towards short third man with soft hands and runs through for a single. NZ shouldn't be allowing those.
Full toss on the pads, driven back to long on for a single.

SIX! This is a huge one! Flighted on middle and Thisara finds the ball in his arc. Goes for a slog over deep mid-wicket. Even half a connection is enough for him on this ground. It is deep in the stands.
Flatter and very full on middle and leg. Perera pushes it back down the ground, Santner moves to his left and stops the ball.
Flighted outside off, pushed away to deep point for a run by Mendis.
Mitchell Santner comes into the attack now.
Short of a length, pulled away by Kusal to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller length on off, Perera tries to cover drive but gets an inside edge that runs fine on the leg side for a single.

SIX! Top edged and it carries all the way, just over the rope! Short of a length on off, Thisara goes for a upper cut and the ball flies off the top edge. The third man fielder positions himself for a catch but the ball just keeps on going and travels across the rope for a maximum.
Another one banged in short on middle and leg, Kusal works it away to deep fine leg for a run.
Short of a length on middle, pulled away wide of deep fine leg by Mendis for a couple. Good running by the SL batsmen.
Length ball outside off, cut away hard to deep cover for a single by Thisara.
Defended off the backfoot to finish off the 6th over and at the end of the Powerplay Sri Lanka are 61-3. The Kiwis were 33-4 at this stage.
In the air but safe. Perera goes for the pull but mistimes it and fortunately for him the ball falls just short off the fielder at mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a single.
Length delivery on off, Perera goes for the pull but misses it.

FIVE WIDE! Kuggeleijn bowls a bouncer but it is too short and it goes past everyone to the fence. Seifert jumped high but had no chance to save that one. The umpire signals it as a wide, a boundary and also the first bouncer for the over. Too many actions for the umpire.
Short of a length on the hips of Kusal, he flicks it away on the leg side for a single.

Once again length delivery outside off, Mendis tries to go over mid on but gets a thick outside edge and the ball races towards the third man region. Sodhi does a good job there and saves 2 runs for side.
Length delivery on off, Kusal hits it straight to the fielder at cover.

Length ball on off stump, TP makes room and hits it hard down the ground. Southee moves to his right and makes a clean diving stop. Throws it back immediately, preventing any runs. Brilliant fielding.

Outside off this time, cut away wide of third man. Kuggeleijn comes around and dives to stop the ball. Throws it back but the batsmen are back for the second by that time. A direct hit would have been interesting though.

In the air... but just beyond the reach of Ferguson who runs back from mid on in an attempt to catch it. Short of a length once more, Perera tries to flat bat it over mid on but doesn't get a good connection. It just manages to clear the fielder though.
Another shorter length ball on middle and Kusal pulls it away towards mid-wicket for a single this time.
Short of a length on middle, Mendis swivels and pulls it away above the infield on the leg side. Mid-wicket gives chase and keeps it down to two. That wasn't too well-timed.
Thisara Perera is in at number 5.

OUT! Brilliant catch from Seifert! These ones are not easy, I tell you. A skier under the lights. Length ball on off and Dickwella, trying to lift it over mid-wicket, just manages to hit it up in the air. Goes a long way and Tim has enough time to settle under it but the ball is swirling. Does really well to hold on with the big gloves. Sri Lanka lose their third! They now need 135 in 95 balls remaining.
Doug Bracewell is now into the attack.
Fuller delivery on off, Dickwella pushes it through the cover region to take a single and keep the strike for the start of the next over.
Length delivery on leg, Mendis chips it over mid-wicket but the timing on that one is not good and the New Zealand openers team up and save a run for the team. The batsmen come back for the third.
Length delivery on middle, Mendis starts off with a backfoot defense.
Kusal Mendis is the next batsman in.

OUT! The dangerous Kusal Perera is sent back to the pavilion. The debutant gets his first wicket in T20I cricket. Comes at a good time too, as these two were cutting loose. Fuller length on middle and leg, Perera tries to go over mid on but is unable to and ends up finding Bracewell who takes a simple catch. A much-needed wicket for the Kiwis.
FOUR! Not a good follow up to the yorker. Bowls it full on middle and Perara lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Starts off with a wide yorker. Kusal gets his bat to it and hits it straight to the fielder at point.
Bowling change and it's the debutant in action. Scott Kuggeleijn to have a go with the ball.
Short of a length ball on middle, KP turns it back to short fine leg. A single is taken. Ish Sodhi fields and makes a direct hit at the non-striker's end but the batsman was well inside.

Tough, tough chance! Fuller length ball on middle and Kusal lifts it over the head of mid on but does not connect too well. Kuggeleijn runs back from mid on and almost gets a hand to it but fails to do so in the end. Does well to push it back inside the fence and save two runs for his team though. Perera living dangerously here!
Short of a length outside off, Perera defends it with a horizontal bat down the ground.

Edged in the air... but safe! Lands just short of Bracewell at third man. Well outside off on a fuller length, Dickwella goes after the ball, it takes the top edge and flies towards third man. Luckily for SL, it lands short of the fielder. Single taken.
Goes for the scoop this time but the ball goes off the thick part of the blade and very fine on the leg side. Seifert goes to his right and makes a tumbling stop. No run.
FOUR! Slower ball, 122 kph! Read by Dickwella and he comes down the ground and lifts it over the head of mid off. Easy boundary!

SIX! Monster! Southee bowls this one short and Perera pulls it over the square leg boundary for a maximum. The sound it made after connecting with the bat was so sweet it was always gonna clear the small boundary here.
Kusal Perera taking the charge here against Southee. Charges down the track and beautifully times this one to loft it over mid-wicket and find the fence after a bounce.
Ross Taylor seems to have hurt his little finger as he picked up that ball. He immediately goes off the field for some medical attention.
The Kiwi skipper misses his line and bowls down the leg side. Kusal tried to flick but missed it. The umpire signals it as wide.
Charges down the track and lofts it over mid-wicket to get a couple. Once again didn't time it to well.
Perera follows the boundary with a solid front foot defense to a length delivery by Southee.

FOUR! Kusal Perera is off the mark with a boundary. Pulls back his length, Southee, Kusal pulls it through mid-wicket. He didn't time it too well  but the quick outfield and short boundaries help it reach the fence.
Starts off with a length delivery on middle, Dickwella flicks it away on the leg side for a single.
Tim Southee to bowl from the other end.
Length delivery on middle, Perera flicks it to the leg side. This was bowled at 150 kph. Eventful first over, 11 runs and a wicket off it.
Kusal Perera walks in at number 3.

OUT! Sadeera Samarawickrama departs! First breakthrough for New Zealand. Good length delivery on off, Samarawickrama looks to defend but is beaten by pace. He gets an inside edge and the ball hits the off stump. Lockie Ferguson gets his first wicket. A very good start for the home side.
Length delivery on middle, Dickwella nudges it towards the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
SIX! Consecutive boundaries for Dickwella. Wastes no time to get going, does he? Length delivery on middle, Dickwella pulls it over square leg with power for a biggie.
FOUR! First boundary for Niroshan Dickwella. Full delivery on leg, Dickwella flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
The players are back in the middle for the chase. Niroshan Dickwella and Sadeera Samarawickrama to start for the Lankans, Lockie Ferguson to open the bowling for the Kiwis.
